### consumeranalysis.net (DR 19)

Empty result — site either shifted to subdomains not indexed or is smaller than expected. No usable signal.

### Proven patterns in cleaning niche (from vacuumwars)

- **Pattern 1 (Lookup/comparison):** hard-floor-cleaner comparison earned 388 RDs. Cross-surface comparison is the strongest link-earning format.
- **Pattern 4 (Exhaustive reference):** 20+ RDs on Roborock buyer guide + robot-vacuum privacy reference. Works but lower ceiling.
- **Pattern 7 (Step-by-step troubleshoot):** 21 RDs on vacuum suction restoration. Maintenance-task friction earns links.

### Patterns notably ABSENT in niche (gap — higher reward if built well)

- **Pattern 2 (calculator):** zero competitor presence. High novel reward if fit can be found (water-to-cleaner ratio? Area-to-vacuum-runtime?).
- **Pattern 3 (data study):** zero. Would require primary data collection (dust retention measurement, battery-degradation longitudinal study).
- **Pattern 5 (annual state-of):** zero. Requires site maturity (60+ pages, year-over-year data).
- **Pattern 6 (infographic):** not visible in top-15 pages. Possible under-used.
